title: Helicopter chases of about 15 UAP in 60 days; never seen from the air

tellings.quote: Then we sit down in helicopter and we're chasing behind them. I probably pursued about 15 NAYA per the last 60 days.

plain: James Valor, who works with Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, tells Michels that in 2025 he went after about 15 UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs) by helicopter over roughly 60 days. He says he saw them himself and that the team would get into the helicopter and chase them, though the story as recorded says they were never seen from the air. If it is true, the objects can be found again and again but not caught up close.
